name: Gaku Frames
description: Gaku Frames is a calm, documentary-style WordPress theme built for bespoke picture framers and craft workshops. Featuring walnut-framed window displays, hand-cut mitre details, and asymmetric masonry layouts, it presents custom framing services with quiet precision. Designed for clear typography, transparent pricing schedules, and effortless appointment scheduling.
